title: Interest Accrual and Billing on Operating Lines of Credit
content:
Interest on the Operating Lines of Credit accrues daily on the end-of-day outstanding principal under the actual/365 convention and is billed in periods set by the product's billing frequency.

## Rules

1. **Daily accrual.** The interest for a period is the total, over its calendar days, of each day's end-of-day outstanding principal multiplied by the annual rate and divided by 365, rounded once to cents for the period. Each day's end-of-day principal includes the advances, payments and back-dated returned payments effective that day.
2. **Billing periods.** Monthly bills cover calendar months; quarterly bills cover calendar quarters ending 31 March, 30 June, 30 September and 31 December; annual bills cover each year from the term start; bills at maturity cover the whole term. The first and last bills of a term are cut at the term start and at the maturity date.
3. **Due date.** Each bill is due the product's due days, in calendar days, after the last day of its period.
4. **Rate change inside a period.** When the contract rate changes inside a period, the period is booked as two accrual entries split at the change date, each with its own annual rate, sharing one due date.
5. **Payoff.** At payoff, a final accrual is booked from the day after the last billed period end through the payoff date, with the payoff date as its due date.
6. **Matured principal.** Principal still unpaid after the maturity date plus the product's matured-payoff grace days accrues at the contract rate plus the product's post-maturity add-on, booked at the post-maturity rate; until then matured principal accrues at the contract rate.
7. **No capitalisation.** Accrued interest is never added to principal.

## Worked period (hypothetical quarterly bill)

A quarter from 1 July to 30 September has 92 days. The line carries USD 200,000 of principal at the end of each day from 1 to 31 July and USD 300,000 from 1 August to 30 September (61 days), at a contract rate of 7.000% a year.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Total of daily end-of-day principal | USD 200,000 for 31 days plus USD 300,000 for 61 days, that is USD 24,500,000 |
| Multiplied by 7.000% and divided by 365 | USD 4,698.630… |
| Rounded once to cents | USD 4,698.63 |

With the 15 due days of the Revolving Operating Line, this bill is due on 15 October.

## Rate change inside the same quarter (hypothetical)

If the contract rate changed on 15 August, the quarter would be booked as two accrual entries — 1 July to 14 August at the old rate and 15 August to 30 September at the new rate, the change date being the first day at the new rate — both due on the same date.
